collection_sources: sources/ records producer, runtime and initial verification inputs at collection.
failure_path_validation: The distributed handler additionally closes TCP channels in a finally block on storage or connection failure. A live SQLite-abort test verifies this path. The collected successful traffic retains its original source snapshots.
independent_verification: Current tests/check_application_rollout.py additionally validates phase counts, source guards, full path witnesses and physical catalog transitions; this checker imports no runtime or handler.
latency_interval: Pipeline request invocation through durable origin completion; includes origin input/output commits and local gate waits; excludes batch admission/retirement.
measurements: Original request/RPC timestamps, responses and SQLite databases are retained unchanged.
planning_controls: ../application-planning/ contains separate path-order and automatic-fallback observations, without performance measurements.
